notes: Deploy PlantOrganism alone on Robinhood Chain (4663). Nonpayable constructor arguments are IMD, Intake, action, oracle signer, ORIGIN_CELL and deployer: (address,address,bytes32,address,uint32,address). Preserve the supplied dependency addresses and action; resolve $owner to the launch owner. ORIGIN_CELL 10223578 is Sintra, Portugal: coordinates 38.78333,-9.41667 floor to signed quarter-degree indices (155,-38), packed as 0x009bffda. The centre 38.875,-9.375 lies on land and encodes back to the same cell. Public ORIGIN and README: Sintra: Its gardens bring native and exotic trees together on forested hills. Deployment starts unbound at that location, water 50, lastSettledDay equal to deployment UTC day; there is no birth stage. The deployer may bind(hook) exactly once after the separate PLANT and hook launch; the hook must identify this organism and a fixed-supply exact-transfer PLANT token. No token, hook, pool, ETH funding or initialization call is part of this manifest. Ended days through bindDay settle empty in one bounded call; the first heartbeat requests the first full UTC day after bind once it ends. One stake rule: stake[cell] is PLANT parked behind the cell since the previous successful settle; mid-day parks count from the next settle and unparked amounts drop out immediately. Challenger nomination, relocation READ and gardener rewards use this retained stake, never live balances. Relocation requires strictly more stake than the current cell and at least ceil((PLANT.totalSupply() - burned)/20). Flash park/unpark cannot move the plant or earn gardener rewards. An unanswered request cleared after 24 hours shares the incomplete-result strike counter; retries wait six hours, and the third strike settles that day empty with a relocation READ. heartbeat(maxAdvance) reverts before pulling a caller fee advance above the cap. Oracle attestations and rotation support EOA and ERC-1271 signers via SignatureChecker. Rotation requires the current signer, a sequential nonce and a deadline included in the signed struct; timestamp greater than deadline reverts. Each previous signer retains 30-day attestation grace only; previous contract signatures use the packed signer-address prefix documented in README.md. Hours, sips, pot/backing/owed accounting, oracle body and question text remain as accepted; callback and settlement gas limits are 200000 and 400000. Death is final. No admin, upgrade, pause, roles, proxy, delegatecall or selfdestruct.
